newsitem.title: CHINA: Rubber Belt posts net loss.
newsitem.headline: Rubber Belt posts net loss.

text.p: Shanghai Rubber Belt Co Ltd posted a net loss of 5.008 million yuan for 1996 against 1995's net profit of 3.554 million yuan under international accounting standards, the firm said on Wednesday.

Based on Chinese accounting standards, the company recorded net profit of 8.20 million yuan for 1996, down 17.9 percent from 9.99 million yuan in 1995, according to a company statement in Wednesday's Shanghai Securities News.
The main reason for the loss was a greater provision for bad debts in 1996, the statement showed.
The company's provision for bad debts was 8.68 million yuan under international accounting standards, it said, compared with 1.40 million in 1995.
Depreciation for fixed assets caused 1.87 million yuan in losses under international accounting accounting standards, the statement said.

The merger of two rubber product manufacturers under the company, and the acquisition of one rubber factory led to a decline in profit under Chinese accounting standards, but laid the groundwork for further development, it said.
